summary: Ostin Technology Group Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 18, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes management's discussion and analysis, condensed consolidated financial statements, and interactive data files. It also incorporates forward-looking statements under the safe harbor provisions. No special situations such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews are mentioned. The filing is a routine update of financial results and corporate developments, not triggering any special-situation classification.
